question: Based on fire MaxFRP in Thailand from 2018-01-01 to 2018-12-30,  the areas with MaxFRP>0 are considered as fire-prone areas. compute the mean Fire Radiative Power (FRP) across Thailand in 2018.
final_answer_preview:
The mean Fire Radiative Power (FRP) across Thailand in 2018, based on the provided MaxFRP data (up to July 11, 2018), is **220.52 MW**.

This value represents the average FRP across all available daily rasters in the dataset. Note that the data covers only part of 2018 (up to July 11), as no files were provided for the remainder of the year.

Final answer:  
**The mean FRP across Thailand in 2018 is 220.52 MW.**
